## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy src tests`
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q`
- [ ] Build/install or Docker checks completed when applicable
- [ ] Documentation and exact file list updated

## Security and data review

- [ ] Synthetic data only
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, client data, local developer paths, databases, exports, or logs
- [ ] No new shell/admin execution or unsafe dynamic behavior
- [ ] Network/provider changes are documented and preserve deterministic fallback
- [ ] Human approval boundaries remain explicit
